scope: Proposition 7.1 of the manuscript “Virasoro Constraints under Projectivization” (preprints/Virasoro-Constraints-under-Projectivization-October-5-2026/virasoro-constraints-under-projectivization.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 065 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 573917aea43c708a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a germ at λ ̸= 0. Near Q = y = 0, use the full Novikov completion with a formal log y adjoined, allowing polynomial dependence on log y in each coefficient. Let F = B denote the branch near the eigenvalue zero, or let F = X denote the whole cluster near the eigenvalue λ. Use the projectors and logarithms near y = 0 of Proposition 6.5, and let Ak,F be their modes. Then, as identities over this coefficient ring, AW satisfies every Ak,F projectively ⇐⇒ ZF satisfies every ℓk,F projectively, k ≥ −1. The operators on the left are infinitesimal symplectic for the equivariant pairing of W. On the right, ZF is the ordinary descendant potential with its full cohomology and actual integral curve labels.
